alerts.header: Green Line C Branch:  Trains are skipping Hawes St outbound through Nov 7 while accessibility upgrades are being done. Riders can board/alight one stop away at either Saint Mary’s St or Kent St, which are 0.2-0.3 miles away (about a 4 - 6 minute walk)
Green Line E Branch: Symphony station is closed for major accessibility upgrades. Riders can use Prudential or Northeastern to access E Branch service. The station is expected to reopen in 2029.

Green Line C Branch: Trains are skipping Saint Paul Street outbound through Nov 7 for accessibility upgrades. Riders can instead board or disembark one stop away at either Coolidge Corner or Kent Street, which are 0.2 miles away.

Green Line: No trains between North Station & Babcock St (B), Kenmore (C+D), & Heath St (E), October 31 - November 1. Use buses between Babcock, Kenmore, Heath St (Rt 39) & Copley/Back Bay. Use Orange Line between North Station & Back Bay.
